primary.root_cause: Compilation failure due to a width mismatch in the interrupt polarity XOR operation, where a parameterized-width signal is XORed with a fixed 32-bit inverted signal.
primary.proposed_fix: Truncate reg_int_polarity to GPIO_WIDTH bits before the XOR operation to match the width of int_detect, e.g., assign gpio_int = int_detect ^ reg_int_polarity[GPIO_WIDTH-1:0];

alternative.root_cause: Multiple driver conflict on prdata_d caused by driving the same variable in both a clocked always_ff block and a combinatorial assign statement.
alternative.proposed_fix: Consolidate all prdata_d assignments into a single always_ff block by adding an ADDR_IN_DATA case, and remove the continuous assign statement to eliminate the multiple driver error.
